def components(g):
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            if g[r][c] and (r,c) not in seen:
                col=g[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; cells=[]
                while stack:
                    x,y=stack.pop()
                    if (x,y) in seen: continue
                    seen.add((x,y)); cells.append((x,y))
                    for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        a,b=x+dx,y+dy
                        if 0<=a<R and 0<=b<C and g[a][b]==col and (a,b) not in seen: stack.append((a,b))
                comps.append(cells)
    return comps

def solve2(g):
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    comps=components(g)
    comps.sort(key=lambda cs:-max(c for _,c in cs))
    out=[[0]*C for _ in range(R)]
    for cells in comps:
        col=g[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
        def slide(cells):
            while all(c+1<C for _,c in cells) and all(out[r][c+1]==0 for r,c in cells):
                cells=[(r,c+1) for r,c in cells]
            return cells
        cells=slide(cells)
        # mirror horizontally (within bounding box) and try to continue
        minc=min(c for _,c in cells)
        mir=[(r, minc+(max(c for _,c in cells)-c)) for r,c in cells]
        # place mirrored at same bbox, check free, then keep sliding
        cand=mir
        if all(out[r][c]==0 for r,c in cand):
            cells=cand
            cells=slide(cells)
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=col
    return out
